title: du Bois-Reymond lemma on an open interval
statement: For all reals a, b and every κ : ℝ → ℝ that is continuous on (a, b) such that ∫_ℝ φ′(x)κ(x) dx = 0 for every C¹ function φ : ℝ → ℝ with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ (a, b): there is c ∈ ℝ with κ(x) = c for every x ∈ (a, b).
lean_statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (κ : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn κ (Ioo a b) → (∀ φ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ioo a b → ∫ x, deriv φ x * κ x = 0) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Ioo a b, κ x = c
